exposure: Tracheal vascular endothelial growth factor (T-VEGF) levels
Gastric vascular endothelial growth factor (G-VEGF) levels
cohort: The study included 43 preterm infants with a birth weight less than 2000 g and gestational age less than or equal to 34 weeks.
finding: BPD infants had significantly lower tracheal VEGF levels on postnatal day 3 compared to control infants, with T-VEGF increasing from day 1 to day 3 in controls but decreasing in BPD infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not impact VEGF levels.
cross-section timing: N/A (longitudinal measurements taken on postnatal days 1 and 3)
